timing.anchor: earliest Sunday regular-season game with local kickoff at or after 13:00 and before 16:00
timing.target_rationale: 07:00 New York is six hours before the normal main slate and still precedes the usual 09:30 international window; the 90-minute late tolerance absorbs delayed GitHub dispatch without pretending the actual capture occurred at target time

eligible_cohort.game_rule: player kickoff must be after the actual capture time
eligible_cohort.m10_pairing: M9, M10_LINEAR and M10_HGB must exist on every retained M10 forecast identity
eligible_cohort.sleeper_pairing: direct comparison uses only canonical identities present in both immutable ledgers
eligible_cohort.missing_sleeper_policy: retain M10 evidence, record typed exclusion, never impute Sleeper

time_safety.current_week_earlier_game_outcomes: excluded from every M10 feature and parameter input

coordinated_capture.partial_failure: write typed component status; never label an unmatched or incomplete pair as comparative evidence

comparison.primary_rows: intersection of checkpoint-eligible M10 identities and resolved Sleeper identities
comparison.within_model_delta: Sunday checkpoint minus immutable week-open checkpoint on identities eligible at both cutoffs
comparison.outcome_evaluation: paired on one declared append-only outcome revision

storage.retry: identical input is no-op; divergent first-write collision fails closed

implementation_sequence: Terra: additive schema, timing/cohort helpers, fixture and validators
Terra: coordinated no-network paired capture with first-write and failure tests
Terra: default-branch workflow polling Sunday in New York time
Operations: prospective accrual without model selection
Sol: descriptive review only at an already governed checkpoint
forbidden: use target-week outcomes as M10 features
collapse source timestamps to one invented timestamp
select the better checkpoint after outcomes
change ranks, recommendations, runtime or production model
